|game_text=Deploy on a battleground. While you occupy at least two battlegrounds, your Force drains here may not be canceled. During battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile to draw up to 2 cards from Reserve Deck.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Temporary Foothold]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-04-Temporary_Foothold-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-04-Temporary_Foothold.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-temporaryfoothold-pre.gif]]) show the original text (see [[Temporary Foothold]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Temporary Foothold]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet (official text as of 16 December 2011; the slip [[:File:VB7-04-Temporary_Foothold.png]] and the Players Committee card image [[:File:VB7-L-temporaryfoothold-pre.gif]] print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 16, 2011"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223114/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a battleground. While you occupy at least two battlegrounds, your Force drains here may not be canceled. During battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile to draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck.” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 30) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Temporary Foothold (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) writes the number: “draw up to 2 cards” (the slip has “two”). PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1274_20">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the same text is in the VMasterType list (captures of 21 July 2012, 11 December 2012 and 11 January 2013)</ref>: “Deploy on a battleground. While you occupy at least two battlegrounds, your Force drains here may not be canceled. During battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile to draw up to 2 cards from Reserve Deck.” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
